name: Cauda Equina Syndrome
definition: Compression or dysfunction of multiple lumbosacral nerve roots below the conus causing bladder, bowel, saddle sensory and/or severe neurological deficits; a time-critical spinal emergency.

typical: New urinary retention or impaired bladder sensation

redFlags.item: Any suspected CES is an emergency requiring immediate assessment and imaging

core: Bladder history and post-void residual where appropriate
Anal tone only when clinically indicated and not as a rule-out test

investigations.principle: Urgent MRI is the key diagnostic test.
investigations.MRI: Emergency lumbar MRI is required when CES is suspected.

green: Bladder care and postoperative rehabilitation as required
amber: Do not delay MRI or surgical assessment for conservative or Ayurvedic treatment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Any Ayurvedic framework is secondary; emergency modern decompression pathway takes priority.

patientEducation.summary: Compression or dysfunction of multiple lumbosacral nerve roots below the conus causing bladder, bowel, saddle sensory and/or severe neurological deficits; a time-critical spinal emergency.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.

sources.title: Suspected neurological conditions / low back pain pathways
